screenSummary.playArea: The play area is an oscilloscope screen with a graticule grid on which a glowing waveform trace is drawn.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you choose the signal source, adjust the function generator, set the volts-per-division and time-per-division, run or stop the trace, and reset the simulation.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Change the waveform, frequency, and amplitude, or switch to the microphone, and watch the trace respond.

currentDetails.functionGenerator: The oscilloscope is showing a {{waveform}} wave at {{frequency}} hertz with amplitude {{amplitude}} volts.
currentDetails.audioActive: The oscilloscope is showing the live microphone signal.
currentDetails.audioInactive: The microphone source is selected but no live signal is available yet.
